title: 1BR Rosemary Beach Rental With Beach and Pool Access
meta_description: Stay in this 1BR, 1BA Rosemary Beach carriage house with a kitchenette, two free bikes, and access to the beach and four pools. Sleeps 4.

normalized_matching_profile.name: Uncorked Carriage House
normalized_matching_profile.description: DescriptionThe Uncorked Carriage House is a quiet & comfy option in the iconic town of Rosemary Beach. Rosemary Beach quickly became the South's premier beach vacation destination, and it’s not hard to see why. The Uncorked Carriage House is a short 5 minute walk or 2 minute bike ride to the beach and only 1-2 minutes to the Sky Pool or Cabana Pool. Prefer to shop and dine? Walk 3 minutes to arrive at Barrett Square & Main Street, where you’ll find all the shopping and dining of Rosemary Beach.The Uncorked Carriage House features one bedroom with QUEEN bed, a living room with QUEEN sofa sleeper and a fully equipped kitchenette with a small dining table for three. There’s also a full bath located in the bedroom. The living room offers a 26” flat screen TV for your entertainment.This carriage house will also provide two complimentary beach cruiser bikes. Don’t miss the chance to experience Rosemary Beach at the Uncorked Carriage House, which is perfect for small families or a romantic couple’s getaway!The Uncorked Carriage House also has a 3 bedroom Uncorked Cottage that can be rented with it and you'll receive a 25% discount on the Carriage House.Home Highlights:• 2 Free Bikes will be provided• Access to all four Rosemary Beach Pools• High-Speed Wireless Internet• Washer/Dryer inside unit• 26” Flat Screen TV• Queen Bed• Queen Sofa Sleeper•. Clean Bedding Program• Shower Only• Outdoor Gas Grill - Propane - Shared with Cottage• Street Parking only. Parking is available 2 houses north on E Kingston Rd.
